statements: INSERT OR IGNORE INTO messages(id,channel_id,workspace_id,user_id,body,created_at,updated_at) SELECT :message_id,:channel_id,:workspace_id,:__user_id,:content,:__now,:__now WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM workspace_members me WHERE me.workspace_id = :workspace_id AND me.user_id = :__user_id) AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM channel_members cm WHERE cm.workspace_id = :workspace_id AND cm.channel_id = :channel_id AND cm.user_id = :__user_id) AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM channels c WHERE c.workspace_id = :workspace_id AND c.id = :channel_id AND c.is_archived = 0) AND length(trim(:content)) BETWEEN 1 AND 10000 AND length(:content) <= 10000 AND length(:message_id) BETWEEN 1 AND 128

tools.name: get_messages
tools.sql: SELECT id,channel_id,workspace_id,user_id,body,body AS content,created_at,edited_at,deleted_at,(SELECT COALESCE(NULLIF(sender.display_name,''),sender.user_id) FROM workspace_members sender WHERE sender.workspace_id = messages.workspace_id AND sender.user_id = messages.user_id) AS display_name,(SELECT json_group_array(json_object('emoji',grouped.emoji,'count',grouped.count,'reacted',grouped.reacted)) FROM (SELECT r.emoji,COUNT(*) AS count,MAX(r.user_id = :__user_id) AS reacted FROM message_reactions r JOIN workspace_members active ON active.workspace_id = r.workspace_id AND active.user_id = r.user_id WHERE r.workspace_id = messages.workspace_id AND r.channel_id = messages.channel_id AND r.message_id = messages.id GROUP BY r.emoji ORDER BY r.emoji LIMIT 32) grouped) AS reactions FROM messages WHERE workspace_id = :workspace_id AND channel_id = :channel_id AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM workspace_members me WHERE me.workspace_id = :workspace_id AND me.user_id = :__user_id) AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM channel_members cm WHERE cm.workspace_id = :workspace_id AND cm.channel_id = :channel_id AND cm.user_id = :__user_id) AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM channels c WHERE c.workspace_id = :workspace_id AND c.id = :channel_id) AND deleted_at IS NULL AND (:before_id IS NULL OR (created_at,id) < (SELECT cursor.created_at,cursor.id FROM messages cursor WHERE cursor.id = :before_id AND cursor.workspace_id = :workspace_id AND cursor.channel_id = :channel_id)) ORDER BY created_at DESC,id DESC LIMIT 50

before_id.description: Older-than message id within this channel

tools.name: get_reactions
tools.sql: SELECT r.emoji,COUNT(*) AS count,MAX(r.user_id = :__user_id) AS reacted FROM message_reactions r JOIN messages msg ON msg.id = r.message_id AND msg.workspace_id = r.workspace_id AND msg.channel_id = r.channel_id JOIN workspace_members active ON active.workspace_id = r.workspace_id AND active.user_id = r.user_id WHERE r.workspace_id = :workspace_id AND r.channel_id = :channel_id AND r.message_id = :message_id AND msg.deleted_at IS NULL AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM workspace_members me WHERE me.workspace_id = :workspace_id AND me.user_id = :__user_id) AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM channel_members cm WHERE cm.workspace_id = :workspace_id AND cm.channel_id = :channel_id AND cm.user_id = :__user_id) GROUP BY r.emoji ORDER BY r.emoji LIMIT 32
